text:
Maya: Thinking out loud — we should try a "silent shift" for v1->v2 routing where traffic is steered by an opt-in request header instead of a hard switch. want: dashboard toggle, per-customer quota delta, telemetry flagging regressions, and a canary that auto-rolls back on error surge.
Jeff: header-based steering sounds low-risk. what's the header and how do we surface it in the console?
Maya: propose `X-Redwood-Service-Version: v2-preview` sent by SDKs or proxies. dashboard UX: small switch per-tenant that flips that header for prod requests.
Sophie: curious about quotas — when a tenant flips to v2-preview, do we bill against v1 quota or v2? need clarity for dedicated customers with reserved capacity.
Alex: we should treat it as the target model's quota for billing+capacity. but for a soft preview we may want a grace window where usage counts to v1 for billing but is routed to v2 for infra testing.
Maya: yep, that was my thought: two modes — "observe" (route to v2, attribute to v1) and "promote" (route+bill to v2). console should show both metrics.
Jeff: telemetry requirements: we need per-tenant delta of token latency, error-rate, and sampling of outputs for quality evals. also a signal when token-per-second changes > 2x.
Sophie: add: data residency tags — if private deployments, header-only steering might not be allowed. need guardrail checks.
Alex: agree. add validation: for private/vpc customers, the toggle only appears if infra team approves. show KMS/region restrictions in tooltip.
Maya: about canary/rollback: rollout-bot should create a canary job that sends synthetic probes and watches these metrics. if error-rate > threshold OR quality regression > X, auto-revert the header toggle and open a ticket.
rollout-bot: created canary job #2461234567-1 for tenant `acme-co` with probes=200, period=10m, thresholds: 5% errors OR 10% lat increase. will post results to thread. :robot_face:
Jeff: console UX: show a compact "version signal" card in the tenant page with mode (observe/promote), current traffic %, recent anomalies, and links: "view traces", "open evals".
Sophie: telemetry naming: use unified metric names `inference.latency_p50`, `inference.error_rate`, `inference.quality_risk_v2_vs_v1` so alerting is consistent.
Alex: we also need to record the header in request logs and sampling pipeline so evals can fetch v2 outputs for the same input. otherwise we can't do diffs.
Maya: small implementation note — routing layer already supports header-affinity; adding toggle + quota mapping is mainly console + billing plumbing. infra-team — any objections?
infra-bot: note: header affinity currently bypasses some cache layers. may see bursty KV-cache misses. suggest we add a cache-warm preflight when toggling to "promote".
Jeff: good catch. add a warmup job to rollout-bot: prefetch top N prompts from tenant's recent traffic.
Sophie: we should define rollout SLOs: warmup window 30m, monitoring window 60m, rollback window 10m. document in runbook.
Maya: I'll draft a small proposal for console copy and the runbook. plan: implement header toggle + observe mode first, then promote+billing after legal sign-off.
Alex: thumbs-up. can someone mock the UI card? I can wire the backend.
Maya: @Jeff can you mock the card? @rollout-bot create a stub canary for internal testing.
Jeff: on it. sketch by EOD.
rollout-bot: stub canary created: internal-2461234567-testing, probes=50, period=5m. results will post to #eng-platform when done.
Maya: thanks. we'll keep the default behaviour unchanged and only enable on explicit tenant action. :thumbsup:
